kind: staged composite: real photograph of the car + generated setting

setting.direction: Alex's concept boards __CONCEPTS/2 (images 75-77): car on a low dark platform in a vast hazy industrial hall at night
setting.prompt_template: Keep the car exactly as it is ... pixel for pixel. Replace ONLY the surroundings ... a vast, dark industrial hall at night used for a private auction ... low, wide, matte charcoal steel platform about 20 cm high ... Grade the surroundings desaturated cool charcoal with faint warm highlights; the car keeps its true colour ... No text, letters, numbers, logos, signage, people, props, gold, neon or lens flare. (68: remove the two flanking cars; 41: keep both cars)

car.method: silhouette from pixelcut on the original; registered to the car in the generated frame by bbox scale+offset with a local search (see hall-registration.json: scale, tx, ty, residual); original pixels composited back, edge feather 1.6px
